raw: Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nsia no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu asubɔnten kɛseɛ Eufrate mu, na emu nsuo wee, na wɔasiesie kwan ama ahemfo a wɔfiri owia apueeɛ nohoa.

norm: ɔno na wiase ahemfo ne no abɔ adwaman na n'adwamammɔ nsa no abobo wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ no
raw: Ɔno na wiase ahemfo ne no abɔ adwaman, na n’adwamammɔ nsa no abobo wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ no.

norm: na ɔde me faa honhom mu kɔɔ ɛserɛ so
raw: Na ɔde me faa honhom mu kɔɔ ɛserɛ so.

norm: babel kɛseɛ no asase so nnwaman ne akyiwadeɛ na
raw: Babel kɛseɛ no, asase so nnwaman ne akyiwadeɛ na.

norm: na ɔbaa a wohunuu no no ne kuro kɛseɛ a ɛdi asase so ahemfo so hene no
raw: Na ɔbaa a wohunuu no no ne kuro kɛseɛ a ɛdi asase so ahemfo so hene no.
